bibliographic.title: Happy Life Home
bibliographic.author: PetricakeGames-IF
bibliographic.description:
Written for the Neo-Twiny Game Jam -- "Create a tiny Interactive Fiction piece in 500 words or less!
You are C4R3_74K3R, a helper bot designed to prepare a habitat for a family about to arrive planetside after a long trip through deepspace. You're an important part of the family! Or you will be, eventually.

NOTE: this game contains music, please adjust your volume accordingly.

ABOUT--Word count: 500, on the dot. I counted...hopefully correctly--created with binksi--one ending with different flavors
